archetypes.name: dyn-guideline-refresh
archetypes.rationale: Review the staged architectural-guidelines refresh retry path and metadata invariants.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the changed architectural guideline staged-assessment refresh behavior. Verify fingerprint drift now refreshes only metadata and the materialized live diff while preserving assessment text. Check that corrupt missing fingerprints and live diff failures still fail closed, and that ship retry behavior does not persist a drop notice on recoverable drift. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
